What is an SEO audit?

An SEO audit examines why important pages struggle to appear in search or attract suitable visitors. Its most useful output is a short, ordered work plan.

In this guide
Agree on the pages that matterTest a finding against a real pageMake the report executable

Agree on the pages that matter

Choose pages linked to actual business goals, such as store locations, appointment requests or product enquiries. Review their search performance and check what people see when they open them on a phone.

Test a finding against a real page

A useful finding identifies an affected URL, the symptom and the evidence behind it. For example, a navigation link might lead customers and search engines to an old service page after a move.

Make the report executable

For each priority, ask who can fix it, what dependencies exist and how to confirm it worked. Mark a repair complete after checking the affected pages. Track the enquiry or visibility measure over the following weeks.
